_notes: === FILL-IN-THE-BLANK EXERCISE — MAINTENANCE GUIDE ===
FORMAT: each entry in 'words' is one sentence.
'source'    : full sentence with _____ as the blank and (base_verb) as the hint
'canonical' : exact expected answer — preterit OR past participle
'forms'     : always [] — not used for this exercise type
HINT SYSTEM (QuizScreen, automatic):
Wrong attempt 1 -> first 2 letters revealed
Wrong attempt 2 -> first 4 letters (or len-1 if word is 4 chars or shorter)
Wrong attempt 3 -> full answer revealed, score = 0
SESSION: 20 questions drawn at random from this bank.
Increasing the bank widens the draw — no code change needed.
HOW TO ADD SENTENCES:
1. Add entries to the 'words' array in the correct verb group below
2. Update 'BANK SIZE' in this comment
3. Delete study.db to force re-seed on next launch (player data is lost too —
only do this in development, or write a migration to preserve player data).
HOW TO ADD NEW VERBS:
Same process. No schema or code change required.
SPECIAL VERB NOTES:
be    : preterit = 'was' (I/he/she/it) or 'were' (you/we/they).
Past participle = 'been'.
put   : all tenses identical ('put'). Sentence tense teaches usage, not spelling.
read  : same spelling all tenses ('read'), different pronunciation.
Written quizzes are fine; oral use would need care.
get   : this bank uses 'got' throughout (British English convention).
TENSE MIX: approx. 60% simple past (preterit), 40% present perfect (has/have + PP).
A few past perfect (had + PP) sentences are included for variety.
BANK SIZE: 1000 sentences, all 30 irregular verbs covered (~33 per verb).
Verbs with 10 seed sentences (be, do, get, put, read): ~37 total each.
All other verbs: ~33 total each.
